parsed.name: MeterCare Lite 测量仪表
parsed.description: 一款通过串口通信的实验室测量仪表。根据现有证据，可确定其支持串口查询与应答，用于在实验环境中读取仪表状态或测量结果；具体测量对象和量程未在证据中明确。
parsed.description_en: A laboratory measurement instrument that communicates over a serial interface. Based on the available evidence, it supports serial query/response operation for reading instrument status or measurement results in lab setups, but the exact measurement type and range are not مشخصified in the evidence.

actions.description: 通过串口向设备发送查询并读取响应。
actions.description_en: Send a serial query to the device and read back its response.
